notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.
